items.title: Elevation Health Lays Out Three Care Paths for Metabolic Health, With Online Access Around the Clock
items.summary: Denver telehealth provider Elevation Health names its three care paths and explains how licensed providers handle prescriptions. Online 24/7.
items.content_text: Elevation Health, a Denver-based online telehealth provider, has set out the three care paths it offers people working on their metabolic health: Essential Peptide Care, Personalized Strategy, and The 90-Day Optimization Experience. Its services are available online 24 hours a day, seven days a week, so people can start the process from home on their own schedule. The company's model combines prescription GLP-1 therapy and peptide-based metabolic care with oversight from registered dietitians, and prescriptions are filled through licensed pharmacy partners. Prescription eligibility is determined by a licensed provider. Not everyone who applies will be a candidate for medication, and Elevation Health does not promise any particular result. ## Three ways to start - **Essential Peptide Care** - **Personalized Strategy** - **The 90-Day Optimization Experience** Elevation Health says it names the three paths openly because people arrive at different starting points. Some want to understand their options before committing to anything. Others are ready for a longer, structured program.
